checks.evidence: A single instrumented-ROM execution reached the real loader return at 0x0223D1D0. The cache held Gate ID 21, format version 1, valid flag 1, and arena entry 0; the 40-byte record matched the appended G2DT record.
checks.name: cache_initialization

checks.evidence: The same execution reached the real clear return at 0x022424B8 after battle completion. All 64 cache bytes were zero and the valid flag was 0.
checks.name: cache_invalidation

checks.evidence: The battle-completion clear hook zeroes the complete 64-byte match-local cache; subsequent battle construction repopulates it through the loader hook.
checks.name: cache_reset

checks.evidence: Host parsing and the injected loader fail closed for absent, short, malformed, unsupported, mismatched, or CRC-invalid G2DT trailers, preserving legacy behavior.
checks.name: malformed_fallback

checks.evidence: FS_CloseFile at 0x0200AADC was confirmed statically and at runtime; success returns 1 and invalidates the 72-byte FSFile handle in place.
checks.name: nitrofs_close

checks.evidence: FS_OpenFileFast at 0x0200AA24 was confirmed with r0=FSFile*, r1=ROM archive 0x020BFCB4, and r2=file ID; file ID 2762 was observed through this interface.
checks.name: nitrofs_open

checks.evidence: FS_ReadFile at 0x0200AC30 was confirmed to return bytes read, advance position by that amount, and return -1 on synchronous wait failure.
checks.name: nitrofs_read

checks.evidence: FS_SeekFile at 0x0200AC40 was confirmed with SET/CUR/END modes 0/1/2; invalid modes return 0 without changing position.
checks.name: nitrofs_seek

checks.evidence: Overlay expansion preserves the original 0x640-byte overlay-7 BSS as physical zero bytes before the appended System 2.0 module.
checks.name: original_bss_preservation

checks.evidence: The original 0x721A0-byte payload plus preserved 0x640-byte BSS and 0x8000-byte module yields exact expanded size 0x7A7E0.
checks.name: overlay_growth

checks.evidence: The 4,152-byte G2DT trailer is validated for magic, version, geometry, record IDs, and CRC before any cache record becomes valid.
checks.name: trailer_validation

runtime_cache_lifecycle.method: One clean instrumented-ROM execution with one DeSmuME ARM9 GDB connection. The arena boundary was relocated before gameplay allocations; the built-in Tutorial Battle path reached the real loader-return and battle-completion clear-return breakpoints. No cache bytes, registers, or gameplay values were synthetically written during the lifecycle capture.
